createTable.remarks: The entity's Cases-page settings chosen by the Business Admin: when waiting time turns amber and red, and after how many days a case without documents expires. No row: the defaults.

column.name: tenant_id
column.remarks: The entity (tenant) these settings belong to.

column.name: wait_amber_minutes
column.remarks: Minutes a case may wait for a person before its waiting time shows amber (default 240).

column.name: wait_red_minutes
column.remarks: Minutes a case may wait for a person before its waiting time shows red (default 480); always more than the amber time.

column.name: empty_case_expiry_days
column.remarks: Days after which a case a person or a folder opened, still without documents, is closed as expired (kept in Reports).

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: When the Business Admin last changed these settings.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: The person (actor id) who last changed these settings.
